maria: Heads up — provisioning backlog in us-west1. GPU pods stuck in Pending because nodes are running a long 'block_recover' step after disk errors. Scheduler shows ~4m wait on node cleanup. Anyone seen this pattern?

alex: Yep, noticed it ~30m ago. Reclaimer jobs are causing write amplification during GC, killing IOPS for provisioning. Looks like scrub + eviction overlap. Node IDs: gnode-12,gnode-14,gnode-21.

samir: Can you paste kubelet logs and the node kernel/driver versions? I remember a similar thing with an older host driver.

maria: Logs (tail):

```
Nov 10 10:12:03 kubelet[1234]: disk-manager: entering block_recover state for dev /dev/sdb
Nov 10 10:12:43 kernel: blk_reassign: block_recovery delay=240s, write_amp=18x
Nov 10 10:13:05 provisioner: wait_for_clean timeout for gnode-14 (attempt 1)
Nov 10 10:16:03 kubelet[1234]: reclaimer: scrub job started id=cleanup-2025-11-10
```
\noncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2025-843 (ops notified)

kate: Temporary mitigation — throttle janitor scrubs on affected pools. Patch: set `scrub.max_iops=500` via node feature toggle; rolling to affected AZ now. Should free provisioning IOPS quickly. :thumbsup:

tim: Also we can temporarily bump reserved capacity for provisioning pools to avoid waiting, but that will increase cost. Recommend for hot pools only.

alex: Another workaround: avoid full block recovery by using lazy deprovisioning so scheduler can reuse nodes while background repair runs. Command we used previously: `rictl node annotate gnode-14 reconcile=lazy`

maria: Applying lazy annotate to gnode-12 and gnode-14 now. Will report back in 5m.

kate: If lazy fails, fallback is reimage + reattach. I'll prep autoscaler policy to avoid double-scheduling during reimages.

maria: Update: lazy worked on gnode-12 & gnode-14 — backlog down from 45 -> 7. One node (gnode-21) reported FS errors after lazy, I'm isolating it.

samir: Marking for postmortem. Assigning remediation to @kate and @maria, and ops team for runbook update. We should add a guard to avoid scrub+eviction overlap in cron.

maria: Agreed. I'll open a ticket with reproduction steps and kernel/driver dump. Thanks all. :heart:
